newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to remove stealth fighters from Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to remove stealth fighters from Kuwait.

text.p: The United States will remove eight F-117A radar-avoiding stealth fighters from Kuwait "within weeks," a senior U.S. military official said on Friday.
The fighters were sent to the emirate last September to show U.S. military support for moderate Gulf states after Iraqi military forces launched attacks against Kurds in northern Iraq.

The official, who asked not to be identified, told reporters at the Pentagon that the F-117As, small attack jets designed to drop laser-guided bombs, would be removed soon because other U.S. fighter jets are now being sent to Qatar on a temporary deployment.
"I would expect that to be very soon ... within the next couple of weeks," the official said in response to questions on when the stealth jets would be withdrawan and returned to the United States.

He said a U.S. "airpower expeditionary force" (AEF) of some 30 F-15 and F-16 fighters are arriving in Qatar this week on temporary assignment and will begin operating in the next few days. They are scheduled to remain in Qatar for several months.
"I know the exact answer, but part of that is still classified," the official said of the F-117A departure."
